name: Norish
description: Real-time recipe app for households. Plan meals, share groceries and cook together.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, recipe photos and videos, queues, the master key and settings. Keep the master key (state/secrets.env) with your backups: without it, saved API keys can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Norish web app, API and live updates, published on host as 6134

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6134, or use your own https:// domain. Sign-in only works from this address. Keep the port at 6134.
